options.text: a - i, b - iii, c - ii, d - iv

solution:
The correct answer is __**a - iv, b - iii, c - ii, d - i**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The major nutrients in our food are named** carbohydrates,** **proteins, fats, vitamins, **and **minerals**.
 
• In addition, food contains** dietary fibers** and water which are also needed by our bodies.
 
• Carbohydrates and fats are **energy-giving compounds**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Proteins:

 
 
• Proteins are needed for the growth and repair of our body.
 
• Food containing proteins is called bodybuilding food.
 
• Examples of food rich in protein are beans, dal, meat, and soybean.
 
 
 
• Carbohydrates and fats: ​
 
 
• Foods containing fats and carbohydrates are also called ‘energy-giving foods’.
 
• Examples: rice, wheat, sugar, ghee and butter.
 
 
 
• Vitamins and Minerals:
 
 
• They are needed by the body in small quantities to protect our bodies from diseases.
 
• They are protective food.
